data.name: MGP Manager
data.detailed_description:
Lead. Develop. Dominate.

Take the reins of a professional motorcycle racing team and experience the high-stakes world of the Grand Prix from the pit wall. In MGP Manager, every decision rests on your shoulders—from engineering breakthroughs to split-second race-day strategy. Will you guide a promising underdog to glory, or maintain the dominance of a motorsport titan?

Key Features

  • Forge Your Path: Begin your legacy fighting for points on entry-level MGP3 machinery, or jump straight into the pressure cooker of the premier MGP1 class.

  • Build Your Dream Team: Scout, negotiate with, and sign from a paddock of hundreds of unique riders and staff. Assembling the right talent is just the first step; managing their performance is what wins championships.

  • Master the R&D Race: Shape your bike's DNA. Direct mid-season development to solve immediate performance bottlenecks, or pivot resources toward next year’s machine. Select specific focus areas and set long-term upgrade goals to out-engineer your rivals.

  • Dynamic Track Evolution: Pit lane strategy is a living thing. Watch the circuit "rubber in" over a race weekend, opening up faster lines and quicker lap times.

  • Weather the Storm: Rain changes everything. Sudden downpours strip away circuit grip, and even after the sun comes out, a green, washed-out track demands absolute precision. Monitor the conditions constantly to ensure your riders peak at the exact right moment.

Your Choices Make the Difference.

The podium is waiting. Do you have what it takes to manage your way to the top?

data.short_description: The Championship Awaits Step into the paddock as a Team Principal in the ultimate single-player motorcycle racing management simulation. Take the reins of a team across three distinct championship classes and call every shot on your journey to the top of the world standings.

reviews.review:
I've been properly hooked on MGP Manager. The gameplay is a great mix of strategy and tension, and every decision feels like it matters. 

As you'd expect this game broadly follows the MotoGP calendar, however you should know weekend's schedule mirrors the one before the introduction of the Sprint race. Normally FP1 and FP2 are the most boring to watch, however, as you are effectively stepping into the crew chief role, this is easily my favourite part of the game. You have to prep for the main race - whether it's tyre choice, how hard to push or what to skills the rider needs to gain. You're not just watching things happen, you're making the calls that will effect what happens in the main race, and when a strategy pays off it's hugely satisfying. When it doesn't, you feel it too, which is exactly what makes it work.

The variety of tracks keeps things fresh and watching the races is a real highlight. Seeing your strategy play out lap by lap is genuinely exciting. 

You are also responsible for rider and team contracts, training the team, researching new parts for your bike and selling merchandise, which keeps you involved in between the races. 

If you enjoy motorsport or management games, this is well worth picking up. It's easy to sink many, many hours into. I'm looking forward to the future development as it feels like this still has a lot more potential to uncover. Note: I have changed my review from a negative one as the developer has been super helpful sorting out the previous bugs, and there are now much less issues than before.
